notes.title: Project "Visitor 来访者II" starts.
notes.content:
Hello, thank you for the support of the game.

Everyone's love for the game has encouraged our team and inspired the enthusiasm of our future projects. At the same time, we also found many deficiencies among Visitor 1, including the degree of freedom, game problems, actors' performances.

In order to make better works and experience, we decided to launch the "Visitor来访者 II" project.

Why not DLC? Because the story of Visitor 2  will greatly exceed the previous one, and the game will also add new modes to the game, increasing your sense of substitution.

The story of Visitor II, linked to Visitor I of the story lines, and a bigger case will be presented to everyone.

New roles, new gameplay, new cases, new images...

If you have any good ideas about a script or an actor, you can discuss it in groups.

By the way, you can contact me if you want to play. : steamhappy:
